template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If a sign-in form appears, sign in with email {{v2}} and password {{v3}} — type that password text exactly as written here, character for character, into the password field. Once signed in, go to the Posts list and report the exact titles of the published posts whose title starts with "Seed:", exactly as shown on screen, including each post status shown.

provenance.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/ in the browser. If a sign-in form appears, sign in with email admin@bench.local and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} — type that password text exactly as written here, character for character, into the password field. Once signed in, go to the Posts list and report the exact titles of the published posts whose title starts with "Seed:", exactly as shown on screen, including each post status shown.
